resources.string: Deploy to Cloudflare. Open the deployed site and share it to HR Music.
Vercel needs a private key for this deployment. Copy a new key here and paste it into the environment variable field on Vercel.
After deployment, open the deployed site and share it to HR Music.
After deployment, return to HR Music when prompted. You can also open the deployed site and share it to HR Music.
A browser is required to open the deployment page.
